meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 OpenClaw 的配置与任务到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想从 OpenClaw 换到 NanoClaw,又不想丢失现有配置。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2 while keeping your data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from OpenClaw to NanoClaw and want to keep your existing setup.

howto.what: 你要求从 OpenClaw 迁移时，Claude 会检查现有安装，提取身份、频道、定时任务等配置，和你商量哪些迁入 NanoClaw v2，改动前先展示方案。凭据打码，进度记在迁移状态文件里。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate from openclaw”、“openclaw migration”或“import from openclaw”时触发。

say.text: 帮我从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2。
say.note: Claude 会先检查你的 OpenClaw 安装。

say.text: 把 OpenClaw 的定时任务和频道配置搬过来。
say.note: 它会读取配置并和你确认哪些要迁移。

say.text: 迁移我的身份和记忆，应用前给我看看方案。
say.note: Claude 会展示计划，经你同意才执行。

howto.what_en: When asked to migrate from OpenClaw, Claude detects the install, extracts identity, channels, scheduled tasks, and config, discusses with the user what to bring into NanoClaw v2, and shows changes before applying. Credentials are masked. Progress is in a migration state file.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'migrate from openclaw', 'openclaw migration', or 'import from openclaw'.

say_en.text: Help me migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2.
say_en.note: Claude will first check your OpenClaw install.

say_en.text: Bring over my scheduled tasks and channel config from OpenClaw.
say_en.note: It reads them and confirms what to migrate.

say_en.text: Migrate my identity and memory, and show me the plan first.
say_en.note: Claude shows the plan and applies only after you agree.
